Thursday, 5 November: the Nifty 24300 PE (weekly, 9 Nov expiry) went from ₹142.85 at 9:17 AM to ₹62.80 by 2 PM. 56% of its premium, gone, in under five hours as Nifty climbed.

Option premium is a melting asset. Time decay works every minute, whether the market moves or not.
